articles.title: How Great Power Rivalry Is Fracturing the Pacific Islands Forum
articles.summary: The 55th Pacific Islands Forum Leaders Meeting commenced, focusing on unity but acknowledging the intense competition among external powers for influence in the strategically vital Pacific region. This geopolitical dynamic underscores the complex challenges faced by island nations, impacting their sovereignty and regional stability, a crucial area for understanding global power shifts and international relations.

articles.title: Internal probe over, Army plans court martial in JCO’s shooting case
articles.summary: Russia is pitching a ₹50,000 crore S-400 missile system deal, with India considering five more squadrons to enhance air defence. This reflects India's ongoing military modernization. Separately, Germany is boosting homegrown rare earth mining to reduce reliance on China, highlighting global efforts towards strategic supply chain independence and resource security.

articles.title: Tata Advanced Systems to explore co-production of Javelin missiles in India
articles.summary: TASL and the Javelin Joint Venture are exploring in-India final assembly and integration of anti-tank missile rounds, alongside component production. This initiative marks a significant push towards boosting India's indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities and achieving self-reliance in critical weaponry. It strongly aligns with 'Make in India' defence goals, enhancing strategic capabilities crucial for national security.
